verdict.rationale: Devin can index repositories to power DeepWiki's auto-generated architecture documentation and Ask Devin Q&A. It also keeps an org-wide Knowledge collection referenced in all sessions and supports AGENTS.md, which together give the team a shared, repo-derived reference. However, the evidence never describes creating a named shared workspace or ingesting existing team docs alongside repos. missing for 10: explicit shared team workspace construct, ingestion of external docs (e.g., wikis/design docs) into that workspace, team-sharing/permission details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
